body.x: netatmo(www.netatmo.com) introdues air sensor built-in weather station ‘Urban weather station’ at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

‘Urban weather station’ is the Personal Weather Station with Air Quality sensors for iPhone & Android. It features Weather and Air Quality monitoring, indoor and outdoor, Measuring CO2 concentration and monitoring confinement. It also provides local Air Quality Index report, real-time.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
